proposals.evidence: Turner nāman explicitly records nasal-less Oriya nā, nasalized Phalura nõ, regional nāu/nāv, and nam. The selected single-word variants, including the synonymous Phalura alternatives, fit this name family. Source punctuation and glottal-stop notation are retained. No analysis is assigned to extra lexical material or unexplained terminal p/ŋ.

proposals.evidence: Turner mūṣa first branch explicitly supplies Nepali/Kumauni muso, Maithili mūs/mūsā/musᵃrī and Hindi mūs/mūsā. These Nepal survey names match that branch, including the attested diminutive musuri, rather than the distinct mūṣika branch.
